steps.description: The goal is to open the OKX Web3 homepage. Currently the browser is at about:blank with no interactive elements, so the first required step is to navigate to the target URL. After the page loads, we can then interact with the elements as described.

The user wants to open the OKX Web3 homepage and then click the '行情' link in the top-left navigation. The current screen includes an element with ID hexa-2 that is an anchor with text '行情'. Clicking this will navigate to the market page, satisfying the next step of the goal.

We are on the market (行情) page listing tokens. The next goal step is to open the first token's detail trading page. The first token link in the interactive elements list is the <a> with ID hexa-43 (text="Punch"). Clicking this will navigate to the token's detail page.

We have navigated to the token detail page and need to acknowledge the trading risk before starting a trade. The screen shows a button with text "风险" (ID hexa-28) which likely opens the risk acknowledgment dialog or contains the required checkbox. Clicking it is the next required step before we can click "开始交易".

The user has already navigated to the token page and clicked the risk acknowledgment link, which likely opened a modal requiring confirmation. The modal contains a button with text '我知道了' (hexa-157). Clicking this will check the '*我已知晓交易风险*' acknowledgement. After this, the next step will be to click the start trade button.

The user wants to start trading after acknowledging risk. The current page shows a button with text "一键买卖" (hexa-60) which likely corresponds to the '开始交易' action. Clicking this button should initiate the trade process.
